prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
 No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: A Garden for the Rain; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: One neighborhood community building beside a paved path and stream. A mature shallow rain garden sits safely away from foundations and the walking route. On page 7 only, two unnamed adult planners stand beside the garden: a woman with deep brown skin, short black curls, navy work shirt and gray trousers; a man with fair skin, short brown hair, green work shirt and tan trousers. This page explains planning, not a new rain event.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Building gutter and downspout; Paved path; Shallow planted rain garden; Soil cutaway; Visible overflow channel; Nearby stream
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 7. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): The garden must suit its place. Workers check the soil and plan a safe route for water that cannot soak in.
Required illustration: Two adult planners examine a small soil sample beside a shape-only site plan of the garden and separate overflow path. The woman has deep brown skin, short black curls, navy shirt and gray trousers; the man has fair skin, short brown hair, green shirt and tan trousers. Exact continuity: One dry planning scene at the same site; no readable text; adults handle the soil sample; layout matches the garden seen elsewhere.
Exact current state: One dry planning scene at the same site; no readable text; adults handle the soil sample; layout matches the garden seen elsewhere.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
Scientific illustration constraint: dry path separated from rain garden; depression has LOW center, not raised planter. Inlet from building LEFT to hollow CENTER; overflow from hollow RIGHT towards stream without crossing path. Use same cream building/redroof/bluegutter. No humans except PAGE SEVEN planners explicitly required; no animals from referenceboard. No labels arrows writing. Soil cutaways are illustrative clear sections, no glass box. Flat clean vibrant colors with solid black outlines, no textured canvas, grain or brushstrokes. Only current scene matters, not all reference props.

visualReview.note: Two specified adults inspect soil and shape-only garden plan in dry weather; no text.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; not physical classroom observation.
